slides.title: Friday Sports Schedule
slides.body: A packed day: golf, F1, soccer, NBA, college football, MLB, and NHL.

slides.title: Golf Starts Early
slides.body: Butterfield Bermuda, BMW Ladies, Genesis Championship, and Stifel Charity Classic all begin at 12:00 AM ET on Golf Channel.

slides.title: Soccer Watch List
slides.body: Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Eredivisie, and more across USA, ESPN, Paramount+, beIN, and CBSSN.

slides.title: NBA Night Slate
slides.body: Bulls-Bucks, Knicks-Celtics on Prime, plus Hawks-Hornets and Mavs-Pacers on League Pass.

slides.title: More to Stream
slides.body: F1 from the U.S. Grand Prix airs on Apple TV. Watch the full day and follow @any_and_all_sports.
